Telescope 3.4 brings keyboard shortcuts for almost every control, a proper Windows installer and a Low light mode for dark rooms. Update both the desktop and the phone app.

## New

**Keyboard shortcuts.** **Keyboard shortcuts…** in the settings menu binds a key to mute, the presets, Start and Stop, the lens, the camera sliders and most other controls. Right-clicking a control in the main window adds one for it too. Every shortcut has its own settings, so for example one key can raise exposure by 1 EV while another puts it back to 0. They work while another app is in front on Windows, and on Linux with Plasma 5.27+, GNOME 48+ or Hyprland (the desktop asks you to confirm the keys the first time). On other desktops you can bind `telescope --action` in the desktop's own keyboard settings instead. Right-click a shortcut and pick **Copy command line** to get the exact command.

**Windows installer.** TelescopeSetup.exe installs Telescope for your user with a Start menu entry and an uninstaller, no admin needed. If you've been running the zip, the next update moves you over to the installed copy and brings your settings and paired phones with it. To stay portable, tick **Keep this copy where it is** in Updates. The uninstaller closes Telescope if it's still running and asks before removing the virtual camera and the firewall rules. Files Windows still has locked get deleted at the next sign-in.

**Low light.** A new switch for dark rooms. Auto exposure can slow the camera down (usually not below 10 fps) to catch more light per frame, and noise reduction runs at its best. In good light you still get the frame rate you picked.

## Changed

- Dynamic bitrate now lowers the frame rate too, down to 15 fps, when the connection can't carry enough for sharp frames. It climbs back once there's room again. Hovering the FPS in the footer shows when Dynamic was the one that lowered it.
- adb no longer comes with the Windows download. The **get from Google** link fetches it when you want to connect over USB.
- With the window hidden in the tray, the desktop stops checking on the phone every 3 seconds (that kept waking a waiting phone's Wi-Fi). Automatic streaming still notices when an app opens the camera.
- The Windows mic card has an **Install VB-Cable** button that downloads VB-Audio's own installer.

## Fixed

- On a fresh Windows install, downloads (updates, adb, VB-Cable) could fail with a certificate error. They now go through Windows' own certificate check.
- The "No phone yet" banner stayed up after a phone paired, until the next Start.
- An Alt shortcut no longer leaves Notepad, Office and other newer Windows apps showing their key hints.
- On Plasma, shortcuts removed in Telescope no longer stay behind greyed out in System Settings.

Found something broken? Open an issue and paste your **Copy diagnostics** report into it.
